verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 has a dedicated snapshot/restore doc page. It covers checkpointing an initialized workspace, claiming new sandboxes from that snapshot, rolling an existing sandbox back, and forking a running or paused sandbox into a new paused sandbox. The coding-agents use case also shows claiming parallel sandboxes from a snapshot ID. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that snapshot, restore and fork work as documented.
